topic: The Mystery Magic Box (Arrey! Magic box me kya chhupa hai?)
format: bouncy sensory sound rhyme (clap, pop, boing, freeze!)
title_en: What is in the Magic Box?
description: Chintu and Mithu find a mysterious box! Join the fun in this colorful surprise reveal perfect for toddlers.
learning: Encourages curiosity and sensory vocabulary through interactive sounds and rhythm.

scenes.text: Arrey! Magic box me kya chhupa hai?!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Chintu the round orange baby elephant looking curiously at a shimmering glowing wooden box in a colorful playroom, wide-eyed excitement.

scenes.text: Chintu, jaldi dekho, tap tap tap!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Chintu using his trunk to gently tap the box lid, blue scarf fluttering, vibrant nursery background.

scenes.text: Mithu, udo aur pop pop pop!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Mithu the tiny green parrot with a red cap flapping wings around the box, joyful expression, air filled with colorful sparkles.
Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Chintu and Mithu standing together in front of the box, hands and wings held up in anticipation, bright lighting.
Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, The box lid popping open, a shiny bouncing ball flying out, Chintu and Mithu jumping with pure joy.
Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Chintu and Mithu frozen in a funny dance pose, playful vibrant atmosphere, clear textures.
Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Close up of Chintu and Mithu laughing together, big happy smiles, sparkling eyes, high quality textures.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box me phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D CGI, Chintu pointing back at the closed magic box, high curiosity look, soft bokeh background.
